# llm_localizator

> Localisation engine for app message catalogues: finds hardcoded UI strings, translates with
> local (Ollama) or cloud LLMs (Claude Haiku, DeepSeek, OpenAI), validates placeholders and
> plurals, and gives human reviewers a local web UI. CLI `llm-localizator`, PyPI `llm_localizator`.
> Prefer `llm-localizator help agent`: it prints the guide that matches the installed version.

## Hard rules for agents

- Do not hand-write catalogue translations; run `llm-localizator translate`, or stamp edits with
  `llm-localizator adopt`.
- `agent-hardcoded` reports hardcoded strings; it never rewrites source. Wire `t()` yourself.
- `validate`, `scan`, `status`, `check-keys`, `agent-backlog` and `agent-hardcoded` need no
  model and no network: safe in CI.
- Cloud engines run only with `[privacy] allow_cloud = true` and a monthly budget.
- Do not invent commands or config keys; `llm-localizator --help` and docs/cli.md are the source.
